en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a wide street lined with low houses and taller buildings, with hills in the background. People are walking and standing in the middle of the street. On the right side a building bears a large painted advertisement and a tower-like structure. The front is filled with handwritten text in Hungarian above and below the image. The caption below the picture reads "Indóház-utczа." and also "Kiadó Fischer Ferencz Pécsett." The reverse side has multi‑language headings for "Post Card" and an address written in ornate script, including the name "Szilágyi János" and place "Hidvég".
